Class GameLogger

java.lang.Object
com.splendor.util.GameLogger
public class GameLogger extends Object
Centralized logging facility for the Splendor game application. This utility class provides timestamped logging with multiple severity levels (INFO, ERROR, DEBUG, WARN) to help track application behavior during both development and runtime. All log messages are prefixed with a timestamp and log level for easy filtering and debugging.

Key features:

  • Timestamped log entries with configurable severity levels
  • Optional debug mode for verbose output including stack traces
  • Specialized logging methods for game state, player actions, and network events
  • Consistent log format across the entire application

Usage example: 

  GameLogger.info("Game started");
  GameLogger.error("Failed to load configuration", exception);
  GameLogger.debug("Detailed trace information");

This class is thread-safe and designed to be used throughout the application without instantiation.

  • For standard log level identifiers
